title: Office-Visit Reversal for Well-Child Care
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Membership — claims operations computation standard**

The office-visit reversal is the amount of primary care office-visit copays returned to the member when office visits are re-rated as preventive care.

## Clause

1. **Office re-rating window.** The office re-rating window is the 12 office re-rating window months counted back from the review date (the date the reversal is worked out). A visit date counts as inside the window when it lies fewer than 12 whole months before the review date.
2. **Well-child visits.** The office-visit reversal returns the category's primary care visit copay booked on every well-child visit any of the member's primary care visit logs records in the window, because well-child care is preventive care and carries no copay. Every log counts — that of the current assignment and that of any ended assignment in the Primary Care Provider Assignment records.
3. **Other re-rated visits.** An office visit that is not a well-child visit keeps the copay booked on it unless a re-rating rule re-rates it; for each such re-rated visit the reversal adds the category's primary care visit copay less that visit's re-rated copay.
4. **Rounding.** The reversal is rounded half up to the cent. For the rounding, 0.0001 cent is added to the figure before it is rounded, so an amount lying on a half cent is always rounded upward.

## The quantities

| Quantity | Where it is read | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| Review date | Day of handling | Start of the count back |
| Window | Calendar | Visit dates fewer than 12 whole months before the review date |
| Well-child visits | Primary care visit logs, all assignments | Visits of visit type well-child visit dated in the window |
| Office copay | Category copay schedule | The category's primary care visit copay |
| Well-child return | Result part | Number of well-child visits multiplied by the office copay |
| Other re-rated visit | Result part | Office copay less that visit's re-rated copay, per visit |
| Office-visit reversal | Result | Total of the parts, rounded half up to the cent |

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

The figures are chosen for illustration and describe no member or category.

- Hypothetical category primary care visit copay: 5.00.
- The primary care visit logs record well-child visits 2, 6 and 9 whole months before the review date under the current assignment, and one 3 whole months back under an ended assignment; a fifth well-child visit is logged 12 whole months back.
- Well-child visits in the window: 4 (the visit 12 whole months back is not fewer than 12 months back).
- Well-child return: 4 multiplied by 5.00, that is 20.00.
- If, in addition, one office visit of that member is re-rated at a hypothetical 1.00, the reversal adds 5.00 less 1.00, that is 4.00, for a reversal of 24.00.
- With no other visit re-rated, the reversal is 20.00.
